# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Apple TFM and WinUI fixes**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.5 backports Apple 26.0 TFM support and a WinUI Projection fix from the v4 line.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **Apple 26.0 library TFM and unversioned app TFMs backported** — Brings the Apple target-framework realignment from the v4 line back to 3.119.x, so apps built against Apple 26.0 SDKs keep working without upgrading to v4. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))

## Bug Fixes

- **WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 consumers** — Fixes a missing native projection assembly that caused WinUI apps targeting .NET 9 to fail at runtime. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))
